raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary
Two DP-attention padding changes:
- With breakable prefill CUDA graphs, every DP rank pads to the same captured token bucket. An idle rank keeps the padded shape for the collectives; a backend that opts in also skips its attention metadata there.
- Decode picks SUM_LEN padding, one TP all-reduce of the summed rows, when the gather spans several ranks, every rank has tokens, the summed buffer fits the CustomAllReduceV2 buffer, and there is no MoE all-to-all or speculative decoding. Otherwise the existing cost-based choice applies.

## Changes to existing code
- `forward_batch_info`: `global_num_tokens` is rounded up to the smallest captured prefill bucket on every rank.
- `DpPaddingMode`: decode selects SUM_LEN under the condition above, both eagerly and in `get_default_mode_in_cuda_graph`, which now receives the captured per-rank token counts.
- `AttentionBackend.skips_prefill_metadata_on_idle_dp_rank` (default `False`): when a backend sets it, `PrefillCudaGraphRunner` skips `init_forward_metadata` and the read snapshot on a rank with no real tokens. No existing backend sets it, so their replay is unchanged.

The prefill change affects every model that uses DP attention with breakable prefill graphs; the decode padding change affects DP-attention decode without idle ranks.

## Verification
- test_dp_attention, test_dsa_backend_dp_padding (an idle rank still selects MAX_LEN), test_runtime_context, test_prefill_cuda_graph_padding, test_prefill_cuda_graph_runner, test_prefill_cuda_graph_runner_helpers, test_prefill_shared_read_done
- TODO: DP-attention serving on an existing DP model, with breakable prefill graphs and with decode CUDA graphs.


Cut byte-for-byte from #45925 (MiniMax-M3.1-Flash support) at 10e655aa98.

+        cls, global_num_tokens: Optional[List[int]] = None
+    ) -> DpPaddingMode:
+        """``global_num_tokens``: a decode capture's per-rank token counts."""
         # TODO(kkhuang-amd): noqa, temporary work-around for rocm 7.0.0 alpha
         # it can be safely removed later, once RCCL fixed
-        if _USE_ROCM700A_WA:
+        if _USE_ROCM700A_WA or (
+            global_num_tokens is not None
+            and _decode_sum_len_fits_custom_all_reduce(global_num_tokens)
+        ):
             return cls.SUM_LEN
         else:
             return cls.MAX_LEN
 
 
+def _decode_sum_len_fits_custom_all_reduce(global_num_tokens: List[int]) -> bool:
+    """SUM_LEN gathers and combines DP decode rows with one TP all-reduce of the
+    summed buffer; take it while the custom all-reduce can hold that buffer.
+    A one-rank gather or a batch with an idle rank keeps the cost-based choice."""
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.utils import get_moe_a2a_backend
+
+    if (
+        dp_gather_width() <= 1
+        or len(global_num_tokens) <= 1
+        or min(global_num_tokens) == 0
+        or not get_moe_a2a_backend().is_none()
+        or get_spec().speculative_algorithm is not None
+    ):
+        return False
+    comm = get_parallel().tp_group.ca_comm
+    dp = get_flags().dp
+    nbytes = sum(global_num_tokens) * dp.buffer_hidden_size * dp.buffer_dtype.itemsize
+    return (
+        isinstance(comm, CustomAllReduceV2)
+        and not comm.disabled
+        and nbytes <= comm.max_size
+    )
+

+            # Keep every DP rank on the same captured token bucket. The raw
+            # global maximum can sit between buckets, while the BCG replay
+            # requires a common padded shape for MoE collectives and attention.
+            bucket = min(

+            )
+            global_num_tokens = [bucket] * sync_group_size
         if self.dp_spec_prefill_coordination_applied:
             # Preserve each rank's forward mode on coordinated steps.
             dp_padding_mode = DpPaddingMode.SUM_LEN

-            attn_backend.init_forward_metadata(forward_batch)
-            build_snapshot = True
+            # An idle DP rank retains the padded graph shape for collective
+            # participation, but has no real sparse queries or KV writes.
+            if not (
